entities.name: Current
entities.how_described: 本集说 Current 是 Walleye 最先进的内部 AI 产品，用于基本面投资，摄入分析师笔记、经纪人信息、PDF、财报电话会议记录等所有与股票相关的信息，所有 PM 视其为不可或缺的工具，不只是总结而是提供真正的分析

evidence.quote: The first was two years ago called our most advanced internal AI project is called Current.

evidence.quote: So the most salient example of where we've done a miniature example of this goes back to set our internal product current, which takes analyst notes, all information's coming in from brokers and these PDFs that get emailed around all the time, earnings transcripts, really any bit of information that's germane to a stock.

entities.name: 智能体 (agents)
entities.how_described: 本集说对于基本面投资，应该有智能体（agents）最终帮助分析，并最终为正在发生的事情提供意义；两年前就基于这个想法启动了 Current 项目

evidence.quote: And so that's when we started an effort to say, okay, for fundamental investing, absolutely, there should be agents that are ultimately helping with analysis and ultimately to provide meaning to what's going on.

evidence.quote: With revenue agents and automations that build pipeline, advance deals, and grow accounts around the clock, you'll get all the context and velocity you need to scale any go-to-market motion.

entities.name: 情感分析 (sentiment analysis)
entities.how_described: 本集说随着大语言模型的出现，将非结构化数据转化为信号——历史上被称为情感分析（sentiment analysis）——大规模做到这一点的能力已经急剧上升，这是量化交易端纯赚钱角度的改进

evidence.quote: More recently, with the advent of large language models coming about, the ability to process unstructured data, of course, and incorporate that into signals, which historically was called sentiment analysis, the ability to do that at scale has gone up dramatically.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

entities.name: 营运杠杆 (operating leverage)
entities.how_described: 本集说如果你不知道如何使用 AI 工具，或者你不在一家能给你访问这些工具的权限以给你营运杠杆（operating leverage）的公司里，那么你也将会过时

evidence.quote: And in future years, you're going to have sort of the same thing, where if you don't know how to use these tools or you're not at a firm that could give you access to the tools to give you operating leverage, then you're also going to be obsolete.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: And so that phrase is one I use a lot is just this concept of operating leverage and not being afraid of that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03
